DISASSEMBLY OF COUNTER GEAR ASSEMBLY

REMOVE HUB SLEEVE SHIFTING KEYS AND SPRINGS FROM CLUTCH HUB
(a) Using a screwdriver, remove rear side shifting key spring and three keys and hub sleeve from clutch hub.

(b) Using a screwdriver, remove retainer and front side shifting key spring.
